rhof.tor_gesperrt: From level {level} you can buy the ranch — you are level {aktuell}.
rhof.nur_schauen: Buy the ranch to look after the horses.

leer.heu: No hay left — mow the hay meadow or buy bales in the farm shop.
leer.apfel: No apples in store — the apple trees will bear again soon.
leer.karotte: No carrots in the fridge — grow them in the garden or grab some at the supermarket.
leer.hafer: No oats left — the feed store in Hufingen has them.
leer.leckerli: No treats left — Marta at the Hufingen feed store has some.

rhof.wiese_reif: The hay meadow is ready — tap it to mow!
rhof.wiese_waechst: The hay meadow is still growing ({zeit}).
rhof.baum_waechst: The apple tree bears again in {zeit}.

reaktion.traenken: Slurp … ahh! {name} has had enough to drink.
reaktion.ausmisten: Spotless! The stable smells of fresh straw.
reaktion.hafer: Oats! {name} eats with relish and is properly full.
reaktion.leckerli: A treat! {name} nudges you with its nose.

rhof.voll: {name} is perfectly content — that's plenty for today!

event.stallDreckig: The stable is getting smelly — time to muck out!

ausgebuext.start: Neighing at the fence — a horse got out!
ausgebuext.hinweis: Tap the horse by the hay bales and it trots back into the paddock.
ausgebuext.geschafft: Caught! {name} snuggles up to you. +25 ᴳ and more bond.

heudieb.start: Caw! Cheeky crows are stealing your hay!
heudieb.hinweis: Tap every crow on the hay stack!
heudieb.geschafft: Gone! Hay saved — and 2 bales extra.

hufschmied.hinweis: Tap him at the gate — he checks every hoof.
hufschmied.geschafft: All hooves checked — your horses wear the hoof seal for a day.

karottenregen.start: GOOBY weather: carrot rain over the hay meadow!
karottenregen.hinweis: Pick up the carrots on the hay meadow!

rhof.schlaeft: Shh … the horses are asleep in the stable. A treat still works.
rhof.willkommen: Welcome to your farm! Tap a horse.
rhof.tipp: Tap the trees, meadow, trough or stable.

tage.untertitel: Three little tasks for today on the ranch
tage.morgen: New tasks tomorrow — you can never miss anything.

zucht.text: {stute} will have a foal — who will be the father?
zucht.fuersorge_ok: {name} loves it — the foal comes 2 hours sooner.
zucht.start: Expecting! A foal arrives in about two days.
zucht.geboren: A foal is born! {name} is here.
zucht.jung: Too young to ride — {name} is still growing.
zucht.keiner: For a foal you need a second grown horse.

fehler.ruhezeit: {name} is still resting after the birth.
fehler.level: Both horses need level 8 — tournaments give horse XP.
fehler.bindung: Both need a bond of at least 45 (“friend”).
fehler.laune: {name} must be really happy (mood 60) — care for her first.
fehler.jung: Foals and yearlings do not have foals yet.
fehler.keinPferd: I do not know this horse.

zaehmen.start: A wild horse grazes at the forest edge. Sneak up — crouched it hardly notices you!
zaehmen.bereit: Really close! Tap “Calm” every time it snorts.
zaehmen.weg: Oops — it trotted off. Wait a moment, it comes back.
zaehmen.wieder: There it is again! Quietly this time …
zaehmen.kein_platz: Tamed — but there is no room left in the stable.
zaehmen.karte_text: A wild horse grazes there today — sneak up and calm it.
zaehmen.karte_morgen: Already tamed today — a new wild horse grazes there tomorrow.
zaehmen.stall_voll: A wild horse needs a free box — build more boxes.

wetter.regen_tipp: The puddles sparkle — the air is so fresh after the rain.
